items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: But like I said, old man, he was the king of all of them, old man Contra, you see.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, they was all Roy and Happy and all of them, they was all good drummers. But like I said, old man, he was the king of all of them, old man Contra, you see. Cause he know that music, I mean, understand what I mean, he teached all of them. I mean, he's one of the best, I mean.
Who did you like out on the street in the brass band? Who were the best ones on the street?
